# qualys_vm_option_profile (Resource)

A Qualys VM scan option profile: the scan behaviour (ports, detection depth,
performance, authentication) that scans and schedules reference.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qualys_vm_option_profile" "web_tier" {
  title  = "web-tier-scan"
  global = true

  scan_tcp_ports            = "standard"
  scan_tcp_ports_additional = "8080,8443"
  scan_udp_ports            = "light"

  scan_overall_performance = "normal"
  vulnerability_detection  = "complete"

  authentication      = ["Windows", "Unix"]
  test_authentication = true
}
```

## Custom vulnerability detection

Setting `vulnerability_detection = "custom"` without `custom_search_list_ids` is
rejected at plan time. Qualys silently falls back to complete detection when a
custom selection cannot be resolved, so the scan would cover far more than the
configuration asks for — a difference that is easy to miss after the fact.

## Default profiles are also global

Marking a profile as the default makes it global in Qualys as a side effect.
Setting `is_default = true` with `global = false` is therefore rejected at plan
time: accepting it would produce a resource whose state can never match its
configuration.

## Settings not exposed

Some option profile settings do not survive a round trip through the Qualys API —
password brute-force lists are not returned on export, and search lists selected
by title are re-resolved on import with a silent fallback. Exposing them would
produce attributes that diff on every plan regardless of configuration, so they
are deliberately omitted.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- **title** (String) Name of the option profile.

### Optional

- **additional_certificate_detection** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **all_qrdi_checks** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **authentication** (Set of String) Authentication technologies to attempt during the scan, for example `Windows` or `Unix`.
- **basic_host_information_checks** (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.
- **close_vuln_on_dead_hosts** (Boolean) Mark vulnerabilities as fixed when the host is found dead. Defaults to `false`.
- **custom_search_list_ids** (Set of String) Search list IDs defining the QIDs to test when `vulnerability_detection` is `custom`.
- **enable_dissolvable_agent** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **exclude_search_list_ids** (Set of String)
- **global** (Boolean) Whether the profile is available to all users in the subscription. Defaults to `false`.
- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **include_system_auth** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **is_default** (Boolean) Whether this is the default profile for new scans and maps. Also makes the profile global. Defaults to `false`.
- **load_balancer_detection** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **offline_scanner** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **oval_checks** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **owner** (String)
- **password_brute_forcing_system** (String) One of `minimal`, `limited`, `standard`, `exhaustive`.
- **purge_host_data** (Boolean) Purge host data when the host is found dead for the configured number of consecutive scans. Defaults to `false`.
- **scan_dead_hosts** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **scan_external_scanners** (String)
- **scan_http_process** (String)
- **scan_intensity** (String) One of `normal`, `medium`, `low`, `minimum`.
- **scan_overall_performance** (String) One of `high`, `normal`, `low`, `custom`. Defaults to `normal`.
- **scan_packet_delay** (String) One of `minimum`, `short`, `medium`, `long`, `maximum`.
- **scan_parallel_scaling** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **scan_scanner_appliances** (String)
- **scan_tcp_ports** (String) TCP ports to scan. One of `none`, `full`, `standard`, `light`. Defaults to `standard`.
- **scan_tcp_ports_additional** (String) Extra TCP ports to scan beyond `scan_tcp_ports`, comma separated.
- **scan_total_process** (String)
- **scan_udp_ports** (String) One of `none`, `full`, `standard`, `light`. Defaults to `standard`.
- **scan_udp_ports_additional** (String)
- **test_authentication** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **three_way_handshake** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **use_system_auth_on_duplicate** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **use_user_auth_on_duplicate** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **vulnerability_detection** (String) One of `complete`, `custom`, `runtime`. Defaults to `complete`.

### Read-Only

- **modified** (String)

## Import

```shell
terraform import qualys_vm_option_profile.web_tier 51451401
```
